### NAME

`the-harvester` - Gathers emails, subdomains and names from public sources.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
git clone https://github.com/laramies/theHarvester.git
cd theHarvester
uv sync
uv run theHarvester -d example.com -b crtsh,certspotter
```

```
uv run theHarvester -d example.com -b crtsh,certspotter,commoncrawl
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

theHarvester gathers open-source intelligence about a domain or organization from search engines, certificate transparency logs, DNS datasets, code repositories, threat-intelligence platforms, and other public sources. It normalizes hostnames, email addresses, IP addresses, URLs, ASNs, people, breach names, and structured evidence from optional actions. Use theHarvester during the early reconnaissance stage of an authorized security assessment. Run it only against targets you own or have explicit permission to test. theHarvester requires Python 3.14 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/).
